posts.title: Jane Randolph and Mapy Cortés ride a bike.

posts.title: Ringo, John and George ride bikes, Paul walks.
posts.description: A still photo from the Bahamas-set shoot of Help!, The Beatles’ 1965 romp. Ringo Starr, John Lennon and George Harrison all have their BSA three-speed bikes, while Paul McCartney has left his out-of-frame to look through a tourist’s guide. posts.title: Chuck Connors rides a bike, reads an article.
posts.description: Chuck Connors, the pro basketball (Celtics) and baseball (Dodgers, Cubs) player-turned -TV star, rides his Hercules bicycle around the backlot during a break in shooting his hit Sixties western series, The Rifleman. Connors starred as a rancher and single dad in 1880s New Mexico in the ABC show, which was developed by director Sam Peckinpah. […]
